column1: # OLD: Hardcoded pages with embedded data
# NEW: Dynamic routes + registry adapter delegating to isServerIndexable()
# - isVerified: false (fails isServerIndexable: published + evidence but NOT verified)
# - Result: Page renders with NOT-INDEXED banner
# 1. Any server entry without verified implementation → isVerified=false → NOT-INDEXED banner
# 2. Only servers passing isServerIndexable() appear in /servers
# 3. Categories/Capabilities pages derive ONLY from indexable servers
# 4. Cross-system linking (editorial → server) via getRelatedPublicServers() filtering by isVerified
# 6. Canonical origin: https://www.mcpserver.in (app.mcpserver.in is NOT a public authority)
# Reason: evidence exists but none verified (evidenceRefs point to absence findings)
# - Verified source code (repository URL in ledger)
# - At least one evidenceRef with status="verified"
# Only then will isServerIndexable() return indexable=true
# 2026-08-22: Server registry refactored to adapter pattern
